scope: Chatterfly disfluency: additional shipped-client static evidence; no target execution, private data or network access

derivedArm64.method: system lipo -thin arm64; byte equality to original slice independently checked

method: Existing REA artifact/Mach-O Evidence is reused. New instruction findings use ordinary Apple LLVM llvm-objdump, not REA decompilation. Function extents use the next text symbol, instructions independently verified against the derived slice. Branch/data flow explanations are analyst inferences from static instructions.

functions.observation: Live ASR params explicitly set language zh-cmn-Hans-CN, asrMode online, model default, puncMode NORMAL_PUNCTUATION. This shipped builder does not establish multilingual spoken-text rewriting capability.
Reads JSON short_utterance via integerFromDict:key:, compares to zero, and sets SGASRTextResult.shortUtterance to the nonzero Boolean. The ASR-side threshold is unknown.
Copies result.shortUtterance into current sessionData.shortUtterance before appending finalResult to ASR stable text. This function does not compute a local character-count threshold.

Registers speech.shortUtteranceSkipLLM as toggleItemWithKey:title:section:defaultValue:, with title 短音频不走大模型请求 and defaultValue false. Registration default is static evidence; actual runtime override state is unknown.
Returns SGDebugStorage boolForKey speech.shortUtteranceSkipLLM. Does not itself measure an utterance or skip a request.
The non-SSE payload builder also serializes shortUtterance as NSNumber Boolean audit_only. It does not establish the server meaning of audit_only.

Obtains enhancedText, records it for punctuation learning and edit/history tracking, then passes enhancedText to commitVoiceText when input focus exists and the result is not the unsupported-command case. Otherwise passes rewritten and ASR original separately to the result panel. No lexical-overlap or shrink-ratio validation occurs in this bounded function.

Result-panel callback switches separately captured strings through switchToText:directionUp: and toggles the labels 切换原文 and 切换改写. This changes displayed panel content; the callback does not call commitVoiceText.

constants.value: 短音频不走大模型请求

findings.observation: ASR JSON short_utterance -> ASR result Boolean -> session Boolean. Postprocessor flag = session Boolean AND debug skip toggle; toggle is registered false by default. Both SSE and non-SSE payloads carry audit_only Boolean. There is no evidenced unconditional short-text rewriting bypass.
findings.unknown: Server threshold, server audit_only behavior, runtime override.

findings.observation: Successful data.text is stored as enhancedText and passed to commitVoiceText. Error codes 0x7660/0x7661 take the ASR stable-text path and setSecurityResult; generic errors showLLMErrorUI and stop normal result handling. Error 0x7662 is stored as sessionError while response text remains available; commit treats this as unsupported command and shows result panel. No string similarity, length-ratio or filler-specific rejection gate appears in these bounded functions.
findings.unknown: Numeric enum meanings beyond adjacent shipped symbols, server fallback decisions, actual error occurrence.

findings.observation: Request takes ASR text/context; SSE handler accepts server final text or accumulated deltas. No recovered prompt or local language-specific filler/self-correction rule is established. Product copy promises automatic correction and concise speech but is static marketing evidence.
findings.unknown: Exact rule for 呃/那个/啊不对, quotation handling, reference ambiguity, negation repair and multilingual quality.

findings.observation: The live-ASR builder directly selects zh-cmn-Hans-CN. Complete arm64 __text direct Objective-C setLanguage: call search finds one speech params setter in that builder; other setters belong to telemetry/config. This is not evidence that all languages are unsupported, and Chinese/English mixed typing marketing is not proof of multilingual dictation cleanup.
findings.unknown: Server automatic language identification, mixed-speech support and multilingual rewrite coverage.

observations.boundary: Whole arm64 __text symbolized disassembly, direct Objective-C calls to setShortUtterance:, shortUtterance, setLanguage:, shortUtteranceSkipLLMEnabled, and key speech.shortUtteranceSkipLLM
observations.limitations: Dynamic dispatch, KVC, indirect writes and server implementation are not excluded.
